small_guidance:
- The current kernel forces `BLOCK_M=OC=128` which fixes the M-tile and prevents autotuning along M; this also forces every program to load the full weight matrix per spatial tile. Add `BLOCK_M` to the autotune grid (e.g. 32/64/128) and split the OC dimension across program_id, accumulating partial mins via atomic min or a two-pass reduction — but since min is along channels, keep one program per spatial tile but try smaller BLOCK_M with an inner OC loop to reduce register pressure.
- Increase `BLOCK_N` to 128 or 256 with `BLOCK_K=16` and `num_warps=8`, `num_stages=2` — OUT_HW=64516 is huge so larger spatial tiles amortize weight loads better; verify SMEM: (128·16 + 16·256)·4·2 ≈ 48KB fits.
- The `x_vals` gather has shape `[BLOCK_K, BLOCK_N]` where each K row indexes a different (ic,kh,kw) but spatially shifts — most BLOCK_N lanes share `oh,ow` neighbors. Reorganize the inner loop to iterate over `(kh, kw)` explicitly so the per-K offset reduces to scalar `ic` strides and the spatial gather becomes a contiguous load shifted by a constant — this turns gathers into vector loads.
large_guidance:
- Switch from "one program per (N, spatial-tile) computing all OC then min" to an implicit-GEMM where the channel reduction (min) is fused into the K-loop epilogue: keep BLOCK_M = OC fully resident only when OC is small (128 here is fine), but tile the spatial dimension as channels-last and use `tl.dot` with the `(BLOCK_N_spatial, BLOCK_K_icKHKW) × (BLOCK_K, BLOCK_M_oc)` orientation so the spatial axis is the contiguous output axis — current layout transposes this and writes BLOCK_N elements via a min-reduce across BLOCK_M which is fine, but accumulator shape `[BLOCK_M=128, BLOCK_N=64]` = 32KB of registers limits occupancy.
- Use channels-last (NHWC) input layout: permute x to (N, H, W, IC) before the kernel so the inner-K stride over `ic` is contiguous, enabling a single coalesced vector load per (kh,kw) tap. This is the standard high-throughput conv layout on Ampere and should roughly double memory bandwidth utilization.
- Consider splitting the conv into a two-stage pipeline: a tiled implicit-GEMM kernel writes a small per-spatial-tile OC buffer to shared memory, then a fused channel-min reduces it to the output — this avoids carrying a huge `[OC, BLOCK_N]` accumulator in registers and lets BLOCK_N grow to 128–256.
